entries.477ad82dd2fb59f8: Its subsidiary Kuromon Sanpei Co., Ltd. operates a store in Osaka's Kuromon Market, also opens outlets in department stores and other venues, and sells seafood.
entries.4cce9738026b9585: Its subsidiary Maishima Distribution Center Co., Ltd. sorts and delivers received seafood and other products by delivery destination, such as mass retailers, at the Osaka Port Maishima Food Distribution Center. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥620 million.
entries.55f4b959bdab4ae3: This is an operating segment not included in the reportable segments, and includes the leasing business, the seafood intermediate wholesale business and the seafood retail business. It is positioned to complement seafood distribution. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,561 million.
entries.5bf45326c1cdd98e: This is the core business of the group, in which its subsidiary Uoichi Co., Ltd. sells seafood at wholesale markets under the Wholesale Market Act. It has bases in the Osaka (Osaka City Central Wholesale Market Main and Eastern Markets), Hokubu (Osaka Prefectural Central Wholesale Market), Wakayama and Shiga markets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥211,941 million.
entries.798d0fe1947a375b: Its subsidiary Hyoshoku Co., Ltd. and others engage in aquaculture of yellowtail and tuna at fishing grounds off Kyushu and Shikoku. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,459 million.
entries.873b606dd9e86768: Its subsidiary Top Co., Ltd. engages in insurance agency and leasing businesses.
entries.a4a6a87df29fdbe8: Its subsidiary Daikyo Co., Ltd. participates in auctions and other transactions at central wholesale markets under the Wholesale Market Act and sells seafood.
entries.a90dfc983edd467d: Sorting and delivery of seafood and other products
entries.abc7b0233a12df54: Its subsidiary Shokuryu Co., Ltd. sells seafood without going through wholesale markets. Through a sales network of 30-odd locations nationwide, it sells to domestic markets, mass retailers, hotels and the food service industry various seafood products, including frozen shrimp imported from dozens of countries such as Indonesia, India and Australia, as well as its own processed products. Fresh fish such as horse mackerel, Spanish mackerel and mackerel are shipped and sold to domestic markets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥139,596 million.
entries.c0c6c2792f7bcc16: The holding company of a seafood wholesale group based in the wholesale markets of Osaka, with consignment receiving, off-market wholesale, aquaculture, food processing and logistics under its umbrella.
entries.f39fdfcb77df3f1c: This business processes foods, mainly seafood. Its subsidiaries Daiwa Summit Co., Ltd. process cooked rice products such as rice balls for mass retailers, Tounichi Suisan Co., Ltd. processes cut vegetables, mainly sashimi no Ken, and Tsuna Craft Works Co., Ltd. processes frozen tuna. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,486 million.
